ghybr_holds_ve_with_earned_rewards.meaning: governanceHybr holds an old ve Id that has earned Hybr rewards

claim_rewards_not_called_before_withdraw.meaning: claimRewards() has not been called by the operator before the withdrawal

ghybr_old_ve_hybr_rewards_before_split.meaning: old Hybr rewards accrued to the governanceHybr-owned ve Id before the split
ghybr_old_ve_hybr_rewards_before_split.checkpoint: before split of governanceHybr ve Id

ghybr_old_ve_hybr_rewards_after_split.meaning: old Hybr rewards retained by the governanceHybr-owned ve Id after the split
ghybr_old_ve_hybr_rewards_after_split.checkpoint: after split of governanceHybr ve Id

ghybr_ve_id_split_during_withdrawal.meaning: the old ve Id owned by governanceHybr gets splitted during the user's withdrawal

assumptions: The split of the governanceHybr-owned ve Id occurs during the user's withdrawal settlement.
The old Hybr rewards are an amount-level quantity attributable to the governanceHybr ve Id.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the numeric amount of old Hybr rewards accrued to the governanceHybr ve Id; the conservation relation is expressed symbolically between before/after checkpoints.

limitations: The report states the loss qualitatively ('loses all old hybr rewards'); the exact before/after amounts are symbolic.
Only the selected impact split_ve_id_loses_old_hybr_rewards is formalized; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
